title: Technology partner program
snippet:
### Gorgias Trusted Partner
A Trusted Partner has proven to be a great fit for our Partner Program, by executing on agreed-upon deliverables, and adding value to our shared merchants.
#### Requirements
- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager
- Complete the Gorgias Partner Training
- Sign the Partnership Agreement
- Source 1 closed-won referral to Gorgias
#### Benefits
- Listed in our App Marketplace directory
- Dedicated Partner Manager Access
- Co-hosted events opportunities (invite only)
- Team Training exchange

#### Requirements
- Schedule an onboarding call with a Partner Manager

- Source >$40k ARR to Gorgias/12-month period

#### Benefits
- An event and sponsorship budget + priority co-marketing opportunities
- A dedicated Partner Manager & Quarterly Business Reviews
- Prominent placement on our Website & In-app App Marketplace (featured Apps)

title: gorgias-developers
snippet:
🤖 1. Join Developer Portal
Sign up for our [Developer Portal](https://partners.gorgias.com/signup) to start our partnership. This step is required only if you plan to build a Public app.

title: Building a high-quality Gorgias app
snippet:
To get full access to all Gorgias API features, be listed on the Gorgias App Store, and qualify for exclusive partner benefits, your app needs to use OAuth2 for authentication.

We expect all partners to wisely choose [which scopes they request](https://developers.gorgias.com/docs/oauth2-scopes). If your app is requesting access to data that isn’t needed for your app use case, we will ask you to update the scopes you are accessing.
